interface.evidence: Original problem lists exactly four one-bit inputs and one one-bit output.

semantics.behavior: Combinational odd parity: out = a XOR b XOR c XOR d.
semantics.cycle_reset_initialization: Original specifies only a Karnaugh map and no clock/reset ports or state; output follows current inputs without cycle latency. No initialization requirement exists.

numeric.width: All operands and output are one bit.
numeric.domain: All 16 binary input combinations are specified; no arithmetic overflow, rounding, or signedness applies.

verification.oracle: Literal original map indexed by independently decoded Gray-code row cd and column ab, not the RTL parity equation.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 16 input combinations forward and reverse, including all-zero and all-one boundaries.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait 1 ns for combinational settling before case-inequality comparison.
verification.failure_and_completion: Use fatal mismatches, a bounded timeout, and PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: X/Z input behavior is unspecified by the binary Karnaugh map; no extra X/Z requirements are imposed.
